question: The Thomas Cup is associated with which of the following sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Badminton male**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Thomas Cup** is an international **badminton **competition among teams representing member nations of the Badminton World Federation (BWF).
 
• It is often referred to as the World Men’s Team Championships.
 
• The tournament has been held** every two years since 1982**, previously being held every three years si
